prompt:
Write a clinical treatment summary (about 150 words) by the treating provider for a patient with concussion after a hit while turning left. The patient had 14 visits. No names, no dates. (Internal reference C-1296; do not mention it.) Work these facts into the text naturally, in your own words, without listing them:
- The reported injury matches the kind and force of the crash well.
- Treatment ran somewhat longer than usual for this injury.
- Some exam findings support the injury; other tests are normal.
- No earlier injury to the same body area is known.
- The bills show no repeated charges.
text: Patient presented following a collision sustained while the vehicle was turning left, with a reported impact to the head. Symptoms and mechanism are consistent with a concussion, and the reported force of the crash is in keeping with the injury described. Over the course of care the patient attended fourteen visits, a somewhat longer course than is typical for an injury of this type, with symptom management, graded activity, and vestibular and cognitive monitoring provided at each stage. Several examination findings support the diagnosis, including reported headache, light sensitivity, and deficits on the symptom checklist, while other testing, including neurological screening and imaging where performed, returned normal results. No prior injury to the head or neck region is known from the patient history. Billing records reflect single charges for each service rendered, with no duplicated or repeated entries. Current status shows gradual improvement, and ongoing follow-up is recommended to monitor recovery and return to usual activities.
